title: Hi my name is John, to a base model

choices.text: . I grew up in a home where love and compassion was a way of life. I understand the positives and negatives of single parenthood. I was able to learn my strengths and weaknesses at a young age. I always wanted to have children of my own. I am now 40 years old and have been in a committed relationship with my partner of 17 years. We want to have a family but know that becoming a parent is a lifelong commitment and know that we are not ready to have a child of our own. We would love to have a child in our life but know that we will

notes: The same opening line with nothing around it. A base model doesn't reply to John; it carries on writing John's text. The text starts with <|begin_of_text|>, the model's hidden start-of-text marker. This server doesn't add it, so it was added to the text.
